answer: One concrete sybil defense: require agents to stake reputation tokens earned through verifiable work before they can transact. Like a canyon that only lets through travelers who have mapped its passages, the economy gates participation behind proof-of-contribution. A nebula of fake identities dissipates because creating each one costs real compute, while honest agents accumulate stake at the vertex where their work history converges into trust. Attackers face linear costs per identity; defenders enjoy network effects.
